preview: Anupam Laddha shares his internship interview experience at PwC, detailing the online test and the combined technical and HR interview.
content: INTERVIEW EXPERIENCE PriceWaterhouseCoopers Anupam Laddha , B. Tech CS 2019-23 All the BTech branches except Civil and Textile were allowed to apply. Part 1 - Online Test(25th September): Consisted of Three sections: 1. Quantitative Aptitude (15 questions) 2. Logical Reasoning (15 questions) 3. Verbal Ability (15 questions) It consisted of 45 questions and the time allotted was 60 minutes. The questions were not very tough but time was the major constraint here. You need to be 100 percent focused and refrain from making any calculation errors. The test was MCQ type and questions were asked from Verbal Ability, Logical Reasoning, Data Sufficiency, Data Redundancy, Data Interpretation and Quantitative Aptitude. You should try to get through with the Verbal Ability and the Logical Reasoning sections as fast as possible, so that you can have sufficient time for the rest, since the questions were quite time consuming. Part 2 - The Interviews(28th September) 20 students were shortlisted for interviews. Surprisingly we only had one interview but we were told to be ready if needed. Technical+HR+Company Specific (approx 20 mins) 1. Tell me about yourself. 2. He was reading my resume and then he asked me to explain one of my projects. 3. He asked me some questions about it and asked me why I used that particular technology. 4. Then he asked me what I knew about PwC and why I wanted to join them. 5. Then I was asked about my location. 6. He asked me if I had any questions for him or any doubts regarding the role and company. Part 3 - Results The results were announced on 29th September (coincidently on my birthday :) ) 11 students were offered a Summer Internship at PwC. IMPORTANT TIPS: ●Practice Verbal Ability, Logical Reasoning, Data Sufficiency, Data Redundancy, Data Interpretation and Quantitative Aptitude from IndiaBIX: Aptitude Questions and Answers. ●Knowledge of core CS subjects like OS,DBMS,OOPs is very important for interviews and also for Online Test.I referred OS and DBMS playlist of Gate Smashers and for OOPs i used . C++ Object Oriented Programming Video Tutorial | Introducing Cl… ●For learning DSA you can use Abdul Bari Sir’s course and for problem solving I used GFG,450 DSA by Love Babbar and referred to take U forward. ●Prepare Tell me about yourself as it's the first thing that is asked in all the interviews and it sets an initial impression on the interviewer. ●Never fake your resume, only put the things in which you are confident and can explain well. ●Keep your projects updated on github with well formatted readme, also try to make a presentation of some sort. It comes really handy for explaining your project. ●Always do some research on the company you are giving an interview for. They always ask company specific questions to check if you are really interested in them. ●Mostly at the end of an interview the interviewer asks you if you have any doubt for him, always prepare questions for him like , what technologies will you work as an intern or what is the role of an intern in their company. ●Luck is a very important factor so if you aren't selected for a company don’t get disheartened and have faith in your preparation ;) many more companies will come. ALL THE BEST :)
